name: FFIST

On 20 July 2023, FFIST on BNB Chain was exploited for approximately $110,000 due to a manipulable reward airdrop mechanism. The attacker could control airdrop parameters and drain pool value via a predictable random address calculation, resulting in disproportionate token value extraction. The FFIST smart contract's airdrop feature used a predictable mechanism for selecting airdrop recipient addresses, allowing an attacker to manipulate pool balances by always ensuring the airdrop targeted the DEX pair and set its balance to 1, enabling arbitrage and draining funds.
